availability.reason: Google has not approved this app's scopes yet.

sync.prompt: Choose which Drive folders to sync

notes.sync: The tree opens at My Drive's root and every folder reports has_children true, because Drive cannot answer that question without one call per row. See google_drive-list_folders-1 quirks. A shared drive's own top level is not under root, so picking inside one starts from a folder the person already opened.
notes.rate_limits: From Drive's published per-user quota, not a guess. Google charges a project 325,000 quota units a minute for one user; a list costs 100 units and an export or download costs 200. The worst mix one connection can make is about 1,625 export calls a minute. Projects created before May 2026 keep the older ceiling of 20,000 calls per 100 seconds per user, which is 12,000 a minute. 600 rpm sits under both and leaves the rest of the project traffic room on the same user. https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/limits
notes.rate_limit_ceiling: One bucket per connection covers every method, so a cheap list spends the same token as an expensive export. Weight the tokens per node if export traffic ever crowds out listing.
notes.scopes: Read-only for now. A write node adds https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file here and names it in its own required_scopes.
